units.summary: New benchmark helper that builds a DB with many series and in-order samples, with compactions disabled. Test-only.

units.summary: Adds a public DB method that filters refs to series without OOO data, writes them to blocks via compactHeadViewLocked with a selected-series hint, and evicts them from the head. Also refactors CompactStaleHead to share the pipeline. Adds metrics.
units.headline: New CompactSelectedSeries compacts and evicts arbitrary series refs from head
units.reason: New public API that persists blocks and evicts series from head; data-loss-sensitive.
focus: Eviction guard correctness when isolation is disabled (no watermark check)
OOO-series skipping and race with OOO appends after the filter
Held db.cmtx during filtering and block writes
Error paths leave blocks written but head not truncated
